use App\Models\Author;
use App\Http\Resources\AuthorResource;
use App\Services\AuthorService;
use App\DTO\AuthorDTO;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class AuthorController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuthorService $service
    ) {}

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $authors = $this->service->getAll($request->query());
        return AuthorResource::collection($authors);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(StoreAuthorRequest $request)
    {
        $dto = AuthorDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $author = $this->service->create($dto);
        return new AuthorResource($author);
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(int|string $id)
    {
        $author = $this->service->find($id);
        return new AuthorResource($author);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(UpdateAuthorRequest $request, int|string $id)
    {
        $author = $this->service->find($id);
        $dto = AuthorDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $updatedAuthor = $this->service->update($author, $dto);
        return new AuthorResource($updatedAuthor);
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(int|string $id)
    {
        $author = $this->service->find($id);
        $this->service->delete($author);
        return response(null, 204);
    }

}

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Author;
use App\DTO\AuthorDTO;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

class AuthorService
{
    public function getAll(array $filters = []): Collection
    {
        $query = Author::query();

        foreach ($filters as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, (new Author())->getFillable(), true)) {
                $query->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        return $query->get();
    }

    public function create(AuthorDTO $dto): Author
    {
        return Author::create($dto->toArray());
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Author
    {
        return Author::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Author $author, AuthorDTO $dto): Author
    {
        $author->update($dto->toArray());
        return $author->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Author $author): bool
    {
        return $author->delete();
    }

}

namespace App\DTO;

readonly class AuthorDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $name = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreAuthorRequest|UpdateAuthorRequest $request): self
    {
        $data = $request->validated();

        return new self(
            name: $data['name'] ?? null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Author;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AuthorControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_can_list_authors(): void
    {
        Author::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/authors');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonCount(3, 'data');
    }

    public function test_can_create_author(): void
    {
        $data = [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ];

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/authors', $data);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('authors', [
                    'name' => 'test_name',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_author(): void
    {
        $author = Author::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/authors/{$author->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['id' => $author->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_author(): void
    {
        $author = Author::factory()->create();
        $data = [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ];

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/authors/{$author->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('authors', [
                    'name' => 'test_name',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_author(): void
    {
        $author = Author::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/authors/{$author->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('authors', ['id' => $author->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_create_author_validates_required_fields(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/authors', []);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

use App\Models\Genre;
use App\Http\Resources\GenreResource;
use App\Services\GenreService;
use App\DTO\GenreDTO;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class GenreController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly GenreService $service
    ) {}

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $genres = $this->service->getAll($request->query());
        return GenreResource::collection($genres);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(StoreGenreRequest $request)
    {
        $dto = GenreDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $genre = $this->service->create($dto);
        return new GenreResource($genre);
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(int|string $id)
    {
        $genre = $this->service->find($id);
        return new GenreResource($genre);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(UpdateGenreRequest $request, int|string $id)
    {
        $genre = $this->service->find($id);
        $dto = GenreDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $updatedGenre = $this->service->update($genre, $dto);
        return new GenreResource($updatedGenre);
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(int|string $id)
    {
        $genre = $this->service->find($id);
        $this->service->delete($genre);
        return response(null, 204);
    }

}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Genre;
use App\DTO\GenreDTO;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

class GenreService
{
    public function getAll(array $filters = []): Collection
    {
        $query = Genre::query();

        foreach ($filters as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, (new Genre())->getFillable(), true)) {
                $query->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        return $query->get();
    }

    public function create(GenreDTO $dto): Genre
    {
        return Genre::create($dto->toArray());
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Genre
    {
        return Genre::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Genre $genre, GenreDTO $dto): Genre
    {
        $genre->update($dto->toArray());
        return $genre->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Genre $genre): bool
    {
        return $genre->delete();
    }

}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreGenreRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateGenreRequest;

readonly class GenreDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $name = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreGenreRequest|UpdateGenreRequest $request): self
    {
        $data = $request->validated();

        return new self(
            name: $data['name'] ?? null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Genre;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class GenreControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_can_list_genres(): void
    {
        Genre::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/genres');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonCount(3, 'data');
    }

    public function test_can_create_genre(): void
    {
        $data = [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ];

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/genres', $data);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('genres', [
                    'name' => 'test_name',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_genre(): void
    {
        $genre = Genre::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/genres/{$genre->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['id' => $genre->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_genre(): void
    {
        $genre = Genre::factory()->create();
        $data = [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ];

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/genres/{$genre->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('genres', [
                    'name' => 'test_name',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_genre(): void
    {
        $genre = Genre::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/genres/{$genre->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('genres', ['id' => $genre->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_create_genre_validates_required_fields(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/genres', []);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Models\Genre;
use App\Services\GenreService;
use App\DTO\GenreDTO;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class GenreServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private GenreService $service;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->service = new GenreService();
    }

    public function test_can_get_all_genres(): void
    {
        Genre::factory()->count(5)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll();

        $this->assertCount(5, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_filter_genres(): void
    {
        Genre::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll([]);

        $this->assertCount(3, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_create_genre(): void
    {
        $dto = new GenreDTO(
            name: 'test_name',
        );

        $genre = $this->service->create($dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Genre::class, $genre);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('genres', 1);
    }

    public function test_can_find_genre(): void
    {
        $genre = Genre::factory()->create();

        $found = $this->service->find($genre->getKey());

        $this->assertEquals($genre->getKey(), $found->getKey());
    }

    public function test_can_update_genre(): void
    {
        $genre = Genre::factory()->create();
        $dto = new GenreDTO(
            name: 'test_name',
        );

        $updated = $this->service->update($genre, $dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Genre::class, $updated);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_genre(): void
    {
        $genre = Genre::factory()->create();

        $result = $this->service->delete($genre);

        $this->assertTrue($result);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('genres', 0);
    }
}
